text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا

words.gloss_range: emphatic direct address whose predicate is the following conditional rationale

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later possessed-servants phrase that repeats the second-person suffix

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:innaka}}) installs the addressee before the risk argument begins. The whole conditional chain that follows is framed as asserted address and as the rationale for the preceding plea, while the heavier emphatic particle remains distinct from the lighter conditional particle that follows. The attached second-person suffix later returns in {{ar:عِبَادَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādaka}}), tying the endangered servants to the one addressed.

topics.headline: asserted address frames the rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is presented to the addressee as grounded rationale, not as a detached fear.
topics.reason: The suffix is the name of the emphatic particle, and the following conditional sentence supplies the predicate content of the address.

topics.headline: suffix reprise and particle contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the opening assertion kept distinct from the next conditional particle while the suffix binds the address to the later servants.
topics.reason: The first particle is emphatic and geminated, the next is conditional, and the same second-person suffix is resumed in the possessed-servants phrase.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle governing the leaving clause and both downstream results
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) turns the ayah into a consequence structure. The leaving verb forms the condition, and both the misguidance clause and the later negated birth clause remain downstream of that one conditional branch. Its short onset quickly resets the ear from emphatic assertion into conditional risk before the clipped jussive leaving verb enters.

topics.headline: one condition governs two results
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that social misguidance and corrupted begetting are argued as two consequences of one condition.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the following leaving verb the protasis and marks both result clauses as apodoses under the same condition.

topics.headline: compact form resets the opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a quick reset from emphatic assertion into conditional risk before the first verb enters.
topics.reason: The short conditional particle lacks the doubled consonant of the opening particle and immediately introduces the jussive condition.

words.gloss_range: conditional leaving of the named group intact, with their continued agency becoming the hinge of both harms
words.root_gloss_range: leaving, letting remain, abandoning, sparing, and remnant persistence; the local branch selects allowing the prior group to persist
words.prose: {{ar:تَذَرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:tadharhum}}) is the conditional hinge: if the addressed Lord leaves them, the two result clauses unfold. The attached object pronoun carries the group forward from 71:26, so the issue is targeted non-removal of that group, not general inaction; the root's leaving-and-remnant field is narrowed here to allowing harmful agency to persist. The same root turns the prior plea in 71:26 into the conditional proof for why leaving even a remnant matters.

topics.headline: leaving is the hinge of both harms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-removal as the engine from which both immediate and generational harms follow.
topics.reason: The verb is the jussive protasis after the conditional particle, and both later result verbs are linked to it.

topics.headline: object pronoun carries the prior group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same prior group as the object of leaving and the source of the later harms.
topics.reason: The attached third-person plural object is syntactically the verb's object and is resolved by boundary evidence to the group in 71:26.

topics.headline: leaving means allowing harmful persistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels leaving as preserving dangerous agency, while local syntax keeps the selected sense to leaving them in place.
topics.reason: The root range includes leaving, sparing, and remnant-like persistence; the direct object and result verbs select allowing the group to remain active.

topics.headline: prior plea returns as conditional proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous plea in 71:26 revoiced as the condition that proves why leaving them matters.
topics.reason: The same root recurs across 71:26 and 71:27, now in a Form I imperfect with a direct object rather than as the earlier request.

words.gloss_range: causative misguiding as the first conditional result, directed toward the servants
words.root_gloss_range: loss, straying, disappearance, path-error, and moral misguidance; local Form IV selects causing others to stray

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the explicit direct object of the causative misguidance verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُضِلُّوا۟}} ({{tr:yuḍillū}}) names the first result of leaving them: the prior object becomes the acting plural subject. Form IV makes the harm causative, so the root's path-loss field becomes imposed misdirection of {{ar:عِبَادَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādaka}}), with the immediate social danger stated before the birth clause extends it. The root also returns from earlier straying in 71:24 as projected harm upon servants, while 14:27 supplies a contrast with divine judicial misguiding.

topics.headline: causative misguidance targets servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is not merely astray; it actively makes the servants lose direction.
topics.reason: The local form is Form IV and takes the possessed servants as explicit direct object.

topics.headline: same group becomes first result-agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the people left in place as the first agents of harm without a new subject being named.
topics.reason: The third-person plural ending supplies the subject controlled by the earlier object pronoun, and the verb is jussive as the first response to the condition.

topics.headline: path-loss becomes social rerouting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels misguidance as imposed route-loss, while local grammar keeps the sense to causative moral disorientation of persons.
topics.reason: The root range is broader than moral misguidance, but Form IV plus a human direct object selects causing others to stray.

topics.headline: first result opens the harm sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees immediate communal harm placed before generational harm, with the root's earlier straying in 71:24 returning as projected harm on servants.
topics.reason: The clause is complete before the conjunction adds the birth result; the contrast with divine judicial misguiding in 14:27 remains comparative rather than controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural servants as the direct object and endangered devotional community
words.root_gloss_range: servitude, worship, dependence, obedience, and service; local construct selects servants belonging to the addressee
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿibādaka}}) names the target of misguidance as the addressee's own servants. Its accusative object role makes them recipients of the causative verb, while the construct suffix makes the harm relational: the group is redirected away from a bond of service and worship, not merely influenced in public. The repeated second-person suffix keeps the opening address and the endangered servants in one frame, and 1:5 gives the worship-field contrast its sharpness.

topics.headline: possessed servants receive the action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the victims are grammatically targeted and relationally tied to the addressee.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object and definite by construct possession with the second-person suffix.

topics.headline: servitude field makes misguidance a violation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the harm as redirection of people defined by dependence and worship, while the local noun remains servants rather than a worship verb.
topics.reason: The root range includes service, servitude, and worship; the local concrete plural noun selects the people who belong in that devotional relation.

topics.headline: suffix echo keeps the plea relational
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening address and the endangered servants held inside one relational frame, with exclusive worship in 1:5 forming a useful contrast.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix repeats from the opening particle, and the servant-root is linked to worship-language elsewhere without changing the local object relation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that adds the second consequence under the same condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negative particle fused after the conjunction in the coordinated result

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the argument after a complete first result. It keeps the same actor group and the same conditional cause while pivoting from harm to existing servants into harm projected through future begetting; its fusion with {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the second result enter as a coordinated negated clause.

topics.headline: conjunction adds a second consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah widen from immediate social harm to future generative harm without leaving the first condition.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the negated birth clause with the first result clause under the same conditional frame.

topics.headline: fused boundary carries negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second result as joined to the first rather than as a fresh restart.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the conjunction and negation, but the surface sequence joins them into the coordinated negative clause.

words.gloss_range: negation governing the birth verb before the exception restricts its output

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the exception particle that completes the negation and introduces the restricted profile

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the birth predicate, but it is not an independent prohibition. In the coordinated result clause it empties the field of possible begetting so that {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) can fill it with a single restricted profile.

topics.headline: negation closes the birth field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause does more than deny birth; it closes every generative possibility except the final profile.
topics.reason: The negative particle scopes over the birth verb and is completed by the following exception particle and accusative profile.

topics.headline: visible negation remains coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the particle as third-person negation inside the second consequence, not as a command or detached restart.
topics.reason: The particle precedes a third-person jussive result verb and follows the conjunction, so it negates a coordinated consequence.

words.gloss_range: negated conditional begetting by the same group, with its output restricted to one corrupt type
words.root_gloss_range: birth, begetting, offspring, lineage, and generated issue; local Form I selects active human begetting or reproduced output
words.prose: {{ar:يَلِدُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:yalidū}}) carries the same group into the second result: the people who misguide are also the ones whose continuation produces the final profile. The verb is active and jussive under the condition, yet negation and exception delay its object until the closing adjectives, so birth becomes a restricted channel of reproduced type. Even though the weak initial root letter is not visible on the surface, the corrected root keeps the argument on birth and lineage; 112:3 contrasts divine non-begetting with this human corrupted reproduction, and the surrounding surah thread links children, parents, and continuation.

topics.headline: same group enters the birth result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same dangerous group from present misguidance into future reproduction.
topics.reason: The third-person plural ending continues the subject from the first result, and the verb remains in the conditional response chain.

topics.headline: begetting becomes reproduced type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final moral profile as generated from the group, while the local clause keeps the core sense in begetting and produced offspring.
topics.reason: The root can cover birth and broader production; the active verb with a restricted object supports offspring or generated type without turning it into a detached metaphor.

topics.headline: root correction and plural form keep lineage visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the word tied to birth and lineage even though the weak root letter is not visible at the surface.
topics.reason: The bundle corrects the root to {{ar:و ل د}} ({{tr:w-l-d}}), and the plural ending marks the reproducing group before the exception narrows the output.

topics.headline: birth root threads the surrounding discourse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears human corrupt begetting here against the divine non-begetting formula of 112:3 and the surah's local concern with children, parents, and continuation.
topics.reason: The comparison to 112:3 is contrastive; locally, the verb remains human begetting under the condition and not divine-lineage theology.

words.gloss_range: exceptive and restrictive particle that admits only the final corrupt profile after negation
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the pivot where the negated birth clause becomes specification. It does not introduce an unrelated label; it restricts the same offspring field to the following accusative profile, handing the reader directly into the two closing traits. Its compact position after the flowing birth verb makes the turn from open generation to final identity feel abrupt.

topics.headline: exception admits only one output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final profile is the only admitted result of begetting within the clause.
topics.reason: The particle completes the negative construction and governs the following accusative profile as the restricted object or result.

topics.headline: compact pivot opens the final beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the abrupt turn from open birth-language into the closing identity labels.
topics.reason: The short particle directly precedes the two accusatives and marks the start of the final answer to the negated clause.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite active participle naming the restricted generated type as morally ruptured
words.root_gloss_range: bursting, splitting, dawn, water-gushing, and moral transgression; local adjective selects moral breach with rupture-image pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following intensive adjective that qualifies the same restricted type

words.prose: {{ar:فَاجِرًۭا}} ({{tr:fājiran}}) begins the only admitted output of the birth clause. Its singular indefinite accusative form makes the result typological rather than one named child, and its active participle form names a character-bearing transgressor; the root's bursting and splitting image is narrowed into moral boundary-breakage before {{ar:كَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:kaffāran}}) intensifies the profile. The final pair fuses moral rupture with hardened denial, echoing moral polarity in 91:8 and the transgressor-denier coupling in 80:42.

topics.headline: singular indefinite names the generated type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause compresses every possible offspring result into one type, not one counted child.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite singular accusative object or result after the exception and is qualified by the following matching adjective.

topics.headline: bursting image becomes moral breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the label as boundary-breaking character, while the local pairing selects moral transgressor rather than dawn or water imagery as the main sense.
topics.reason: The broader root includes physical bursting fields, but the adjacent denial adjective and active participle form select moral transgression.

topics.headline: first final trait opens the coupled closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears moral rupture and intensified denial as one coupled final identity, with 91:8 and 80:42 supplying useful moral-pairing echoes.
topics.reason: The word begins the final adjective pair, matches the following word in accusative indefinite form, and can be compared with moral polarity in 91:8 and the transgressor-denier coupling in 80:42.

words.gloss_range: intensive adjective qualifying the same restricted offspring type as habitual denial
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, denial, ingratitude, disbelief, expiation, and declaration fields; local intensive adjective selects repeated denial or ingratitude

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding accusative participle that the final adjective qualifies

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَّارًۭا}} ({{tr:kaffāran}}) seals the ayah by qualifying the same generated type, not by adding a second child. Agreement keeps it locked to {{ar:فَاجِرًۭا}} ({{tr:fājiran}}), the intensive pattern makes denial habitual and excessive, and the root's covering image is narrowed here into repeated covering-over of truth or obligation. The paired cadence and doubled consonant make this denial the heavier endpoint, carrying the present unbelieving class of 71:26 into a reproduced intensified outcome; 14:34 supplies a contrastive intensive-pattern echo for human ingratitude.

topics.headline: agreement locks the final word to the same type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intensified denial qualifies the same offspring profile rather than naming a separate result.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the preceding accusative indefinite and remains within the restricted object phrase.

topics.headline: covering image becomes habitual denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels denial as repeated covering-over and ingratitude, while local context excludes expiation or mere declaration as the selected branch.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the final intensive adjective after the moral-transgressor label selects habitual denial and ingratitude.

topics.headline: final word escalates and closes the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah land on intensified denial as the endpoint of the sequence from present unbelieving class in 71:26 to reproduced future type in 71:27.
topics.reason: The word is ayah-final, echoes the preceding accusative cadence, and links the same root from the prior class in 71:26 to the intensified outcome here; 14:34 supplies a contrastive intensive-pattern echo.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional 'if You leave them' governs two coordinated outcomes: misleading Your servants and begetting only a fajir kaffar.
baseline_models.mechanism: Continued presence preserves a system through two coupled channels: it diverts already-existing servants from their aim and generates a successor type marked by breached restraint and covered truth. Horizontal recruitment and vertical succession make the threat self-renewing rather than a list of isolated offenses.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies the persistence condition that permits both downstream effects.
Deviation from guidance and aim supplies the horizontal redirection imposed on the servants.
Worship and submissive obedience make the endangered relation one of practiced allegiance, not information alone.
Born offspring supplies the literal vertical channel by which the acting group continues.
A thing generated from another broadens birth into the production of a repeatable successor outcome.
Departure from right through a breach of restraint supplies the successor's outward transgressive action.
Covering or rejecting truth supplies the successor's inwardly maintained refusal.

changed_reading.before: If spared, bad people will mislead others and have bad children.
changed_reading.after: If preserved, the group renews itself by capturing present allegiance and producing successors whose breached restraint and truth-covering perpetuate the same system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restricted object of birth is the paired description fajiran kaffara.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two predicates form a complementary profile: fajr breaks outward through a limit, while kufr covers inward over what should remain visible. The pair therefore describes an agent who removes moral restraints while sealing off correction.

activation_trace.role: Breach of restraint supplies the outward opening through an acknowledged boundary.
Covering and concealment supply the counter-motion that blocks exposure or correction.
Rejection of truth specifies what the covering motion protects from acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Fajir and kaffar are two cumulative terms of abuse.
changed_reading.after: They diagnose a coupled type: unrestrained outward breach joined to inward concealment of the truth that could arrest it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object of misleading is not an unmarked population but 'Your servants,' with the possessive relation made explicit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Misguidance alienates servants from the relation named as God's. The loss branch of dall and the owned or obedient branches of abd make the injury relational: the servants are made to lose their proper orientation and become functionally available to a rival direction.

activation_trace.role: Owned status makes the possessive 'Your' a concrete relation whose claims are being usurped.
Submissive worship identifies allegiance as the functional content of that relation.
Losing what belongs to an owner supplies the image of relational displacement rather than mere error.

changed_reading.before: They will cause some people to hold false beliefs.
changed_reading.after: They will displace God's servants from their proper allegiance and redirect the obedience that defines their servant relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening command defines the endangered servants by worship of God and obedient response. When 71:27 says the opponents will mislead 'Your servants,' the harm becomes capture of enacted allegiance: the rival group redirects bodies and loyalties that had been summoned toward God.

activation_trace.role: The command to worship supplies submissive obedience as the intended practice later endangered in 'Your servants.'
The worshiped deity identifies God as the intended object from whom allegiance can be diverted.
Compliance and obedience supply the behavioral channel through which allegiance is expressed and captured.
Deviation from guidance names the redirection performed on that commanded allegiance.
The servant term anchors the context's worship-and-obedience relation inside the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 71:3 places worship and obedience in one imperative series, while 71:27 returns to the same ع ب د root for the people at risk.
The second-person possessive in 'Your servants' keeps the contested allegiance explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared servant root and the worship-obedience series; I infer that causing astray reallocates practiced allegiance, not only propositions. A live alternative is that 'Your servants' is simply a universal designation without this narrower vocational force.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance is chiefly transfer of false ideas.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance is rival capture of the worship and obedience through which God's servants enact their allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response to repeated invitation runs from flight to bodily self-covering, then to hardened persistence and self-exaltation. This sequence revises 'beget only' from a bare biological forecast into reproduction of a learned refusal script: successors are generated inside a practice that evades the call, covers access, and hardens against correction.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the corrective address against which the refusal sequence operates.
Flight supplies the first evasive movement produced by the call.
A covering laid over a thing supplies deliberate sensory and cognitive enclosure.
Garment and covering give that enclosure its bodily instrument.
Persistence and resolve turn momentary avoidance into a maintained disposition.
Self-magnification supplies the status posture that seals the refusal against correction.
Generation from something else lets the focus describe production of a reproduced behavioral type while retaining literal birth.
Covering and concealment name the mature form of the context's enacted self-covering.
Breach of restraint names the active conduct paired with the sealed refusal.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 varies the invitation across night, day, public, and private modes before narrating a stable refusal response.
71:7 orders concrete blocking, covering, persistence, and self-exaltation as an escalating chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated address and a stable embodied response; I infer that a household or group can transmit this response as a script to what it generates. Literal moral prediction about offspring remains a live alternative and is not replaced by the social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The offspring are condemned as bad by an unexplained inherited quality.
changed_reading.after: The group reproduces successors inside an embodied refusal practice that repeatedly converts corrective address into flight, covering, persistence, and pride.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 71:21, following is organized around a figure whose wealth and offspring increase only loss. That joins the focus ayah's horizontal misleading and vertical begetting into one social amplifier: resources and lineage give a leader reach, followers extend it laterally, and offspring continue it temporally.

activation_trace.role: Following behind supplies the lateral recruitment relation by which a powerful figure acquires adherents.
Increase and growth supply the amplifying direction of the leader's assets and consequences.
Accumulated wealth supplies material capacity and prestige for attracting and sustaining followers.
Offspring supply lineage as a second asset and the temporal continuation of influence.
General loss supplies the negative output to which the whole wealth-lineage-following network contributes.
Causing deviation names the focus ayah's lateral effect on recruited servants.
Begetting offspring names the focus ayah's vertical continuation of the same influence.

structural_cues: 71:21 places following before the paired assets of wealth and offspring, then gives their net effect as increased loss.
71:27 likewise coordinates an effect on present servants with an effect on future offspring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followers, wealth, offspring, increase, and loss in one sentence; I infer a status-backed transmission network linking them. The live alternative is that wealth and offspring are only personal blessings turned harmful, without functioning as instruments of recruitment.

changed_reading.before: Misleading others and having corrupt children are separate predictions.
changed_reading.after: They are the lateral and vertical outputs of one status-and-lineage network that uses resources, followers, and descendants to amplify loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents twice command one another not to leave their gods; Noah then asks God not to leave a disbelieving resident, and the focus states what follows if God leaves them. The repeated verb becomes a contested preservation policy: preserving the cult objects requires preserving their custodians, while preserving the custodians perpetuates captured servants and successors.

activation_trace.role: The doubled command not to leave supplies the opponents' policy of keeping their worship system intact.
Noah's matching request not to leave reverses the same preservation verb against the system's human carriers.
Objects of worship identify what the opponents seek to preserve through their doubled command.
The conditional reuse of leaving makes the focus ayah the causal explanation of Noah's reversed policy.
Worship and obedience identify the human allegiance that continued preservation would redirect.

structural_cues: The same leaving verb appears twice in 71:23, once in 71:26, and conditionally in 71:27.
71:27 begins with an explicit causal particle and directly justifies the request in 71:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical mirror and adjacent causal syntax; I infer that the two imperatives encode opposing preservation programs. A live alternative is that each use means only physical non-abandonment and carries no policy-level contrast.

changed_reading.before: The conditional merely explains why these people should not survive.
changed_reading.after: It resolves a struggle over what is to be preserved: leaving the cult's carriers in place lets them preserve its objects by reproducing redirected worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior report that they have already misled many gives the conditional future an observed base, while the prayer that the wrongdoers increase only in misguidance gives it a compounding direction. The focus is therefore a projection of a demonstrated feedback process: misguidance already produced becomes the condition for producing more misguidance and similarly formed successors.

activation_trace.role: The paired causative and noun report deviation already caused and the same deviation requested as the field of further increase.
Increase and growth supply the recursive direction by which existing misguidance compounds.
The future causative deviation projects the already observed process onto servants if the agents remain.
Generation from an antecedent turns the compounding process into production of a successor output.

structural_cues: 71:24 moves from a completed causative claim to a restrictive prayer for increase only in misguidance.
71:27 moves from conditional future misleading to the parallel restriction 'they beget only.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past output, requested increase, and future projection; I infer a stable feedback process linking them. Because 71:24 shifts from report to prayer, a live alternative is rhetorical intensification rather than a causal loop.

changed_reading.before: Noah predicts a future danger without an explicit evidentiary basis.
changed_reading.after: The future danger extrapolates an already demonstrated, compounding process in which produced misguidance generates further misguidance and successor agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse places Noah's own parents within forgiveness and admits a believer through the boundary of his house before including believing men and women. That contrast blocks a universal genetic reading of 'they beget only': the focus judges the reproductive and household ecology of the antagonistic 'they,' while the next verse displays parenthood, household entry, and belief in a different configuration.

activation_trace.role: Parents by birth place the same lineage domain inside a positive prayer rather than an intrinsically corrupt category.
Household members supply a social container in which affiliation and formation need not reduce to descent.
Belief that settles the heart supplies the qualifying state for the entrant and the inclusive community beyond lineage.
Literal offspring keeps actual parent-child succession present in the focus claim.
A generated outcome permits household and social production to coexist with literal descent.

structural_cues: 71:28 follows immediately and coordinates parents, a believing house-entrant, believing men, and believing women within one prayer.
The condemned subject in 71:27 remains the bounded plural 'they,' not birth or parenthood as such.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate positive lineage-and-household contrast; I infer that the focus diagnoses a group's transmission ecology rather than fixed heredity. The alternative remains that Noah's parents and house simply fall outside the condemned group's lineage, leaving the focus's literal biological force stronger.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts that moral corruption is biologically inevitable in offspring.
changed_reading.after: It judges what this particular antagonistic lineage-household system reliably produces, while the next verse preserves parenthood, household entry, and belief as a contrary formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the farmer/seed branch of kufr rather than its ordinary truth-rejection branch. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of generating, breaking forth, and covering, and in 71:17's explicit human-as-growth image. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for counterfeit cultivation, never as a claim that kaffar here lexically means farmer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins begetting, a term with splitting or outflow imagery, and a term whose branch inventory includes covering seed.

activation_trace.role: Planting and cultivation supply the surah's explicit growth frame for human production.

A generated or derived thing anchors the analogy in the focus ayah's production verb.

Covering seed supplies the branch-distant cultivation image for a system that plants concealment into what it produces.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts a morally corrupt child.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it depicts a counter-cultivation: the preserved group generates a crop that breaks forth by breaching limits while reproducing the covering of truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the detached-piece branch of wadhara with a branch-distant cycle image from dayyaran. It remains anchored in the focus's condition of leaving and its generation clause, while the adjacent prayers name a resident and seek destruction. Downstream prose should qualify it as a system-remnant analogy, not a lexical gloss of either tadhar or dayyaran.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The condition asks what happens if any of the acting group is left, and the result includes renewed generation.

activation_trace.role: The resident or house-affiliated person identifies the concrete human remainder Noah asks not to leave.
Circulation of conditions supplies the exploratory possibility that a surviving node can turn the system through another cycle.
Destruction, annulment, and breaking supply the requested opposite of leaving a regenerative remainder.
A detached piece supplies the focus-anchored image of a remnant left after the larger body is removed.
Generation from something else supplies the remnant's inferred capacity to reconstitute the pattern.

changed_reading.before: No single disbelieving resident should remain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no operative remnant should remain from which the misleading system can generate and cycle into a new form.

strongest_changes: The exact leaving-verb reversal turns 71:27 into the causal center of opposing preservation programs: keep the gods versus remove their reproducing custodians.
The response sequence of flight, self-covering, persistence, and pride makes the born successor a socially reproduced refusal type as well as literal offspring.
Followers, wealth, and offspring reveal horizontal recruitment and vertical lineage as one amplifier, while 71:28's parents, house, and believers block genetic essentialization.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses a whole transmission mechanism into one conditional: leaving enables allegiance capture and successor production. Context makes that mechanism visible through repeated preservation language, embodied refusal, prestige-backed following, and a contrasting believing household.
remaining_uncertainties: How much semantic weight should fall on literal childbirth versus the broader branch of generating a derived outcome?
Does 71:24 establish an actual feedback mechanism or only intensify the prayer through repeated restrictive language?
The cultivation and regenerative-remnant models are branch-distant material analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The causal claim joins social transmission to biological transmission.** **و ذ ر B003** supplies leaving in place, **ض ل ل B001** causing departure from guidance, **ع ب د B003** worship and submissive obedience, **و ل د B003** birth, **ف ج ر B004** departure from right, and **ك ف ر B003** truth-rejection. The conditional first predicts corruption of existing servants, then the coordinated clause predicts reproduction of the same disposition. The packet supplies both pathways; the abductive arrow is that a surviving social order transmits its orientation through teaching and birth. The ayah reads as a two-channel reproduction mechanism.

2. **Misguidance again reassigns servitude.** In 71:3 Noah commanded worship through **ع ب د B003**; 71:21 showed disobedience followed by compliance with another. Here the object is “Your servants.” The inferred relation is that leading servants astray does not free them from service but redirects their submissive obedience. The possessive attachment to God makes the usurpation especially visible.

3. **The offspring combines rupture with intensified covering.** **ف ج ر B001** supplies wide splitting and outflow, while **B004** supplies breach of restraint; **ك ف ر B001** supplies covering, and **B003** rejection. The adjacent nouns therefore hold opposed material motions: bursting open and covering shut. The packet supplies those branches; the abductive role is to model a person whose restraint ruptures outward while truth is sealed inward. The ayah gains a compact morphology of transmitted disorder.

4. **A corrupted water-and-seed cycle shadows birth.** **ف ج ر B001** includes water bursting into channels, **ك ف ر B008** seed-covering cultivation, and **ك ف ر B010** fruit covering; 71:11–17 supplied rain, gardens, and human growth. The direct moral branches remain **ف ج ر B004** and **ك ف ر B003**. The inferred reversal is that the earlier fertile ecology now reproduces breached channels and covered truth. Birth is read as corrupted cultivation, not as neutral increase.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:28 was a necessary correction: parents, household, and believing men and women show that genealogy can transmit trust as well as rupture and covering. The later ayah therefore blocks a biologically deterministic reading and locates the problem in a reproduced social-moral system.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A stated two-channel reproduction mechanism.** **Lexical evidence:** `و ذ ر B003` is letting remain, `ض ل ل B001` is causing deviation from aim, and `و ل د B003` is birth. **Structural cue:** the conditional explicitly gives two outputs of leaving: misdirecting existing servants and producing a new generation. **Assigned role:** persuasion propagates horizontally, while birth extends the system temporally. **Abductive move:** the causal arrows are supplied by the verse; I infer only that together they explain the request at 71:26. **Reading change:** the prayer targets a self-reproducing network, not isolated individuals.

2. **Birth as social derivation, not biological fate.** **Lexical evidence:** dormant `و ل د B005` is a generated or derived thing; `ف ج ر B004` is departure from right and breach of restraint; `ك ف ر B003` is rejection or covering of truth. **Structural cue:** plotting, named commands, and mass misguidance at 71:22-24 precede the claim about what is generated. **Assigned role:** the social environment produces a recognizable moral type. **Abductive move:** I infer cultural derivation from the preceding mechanism; this avoids treating the description as an essential property of biology. **Reading change:** `يلدوا` includes reproduction of formation and allegiance.

3. **Service contested by misdirection.** **Lexical evidence:** `ع ب د B003` is worship and submissive obedience in `عِبَادَكَ`; `ء ل ه B001` at 71:23 marks objects treated as worshipped. **Structural cue:** those preserved objects stand behind the predicted misguidance of God's servants. **Assigned role:** misguidance redirects service from its named relation toward socially maintained objects. **Abductive move:** I infer an allegiance contest from the two worship roots. **Reading change:** `عبادك` identifies people as service-bearing agents whose orientation can be captured.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The closing prayer at 71:28 supplied a non-biological counter-lineage: self, parents, house-entrant, and believing men and women are joined by trust rather than deviant formation. This confirmed that the birth claim concerns reproduced allegiance, not immutable biological essence.

baseline.text: Çünkü onları bırakırsan kullarını saptırırlar ve yalnızca günahkâr ve koyu inkârcı çocuklar doğururlar.

findings.text: Mevcut kulları saptırma ile yeni kuşak doğurma birlikte, yanlış yönelimin hem toplum içinde yatay hem de zaman içinde kuşaklar boyunca yayılan kendini yenileyen bir düzen olduğunu gösterir.
Doğurmanın 'bir şeyi üretip türetme' çağrışımı, sonraki inanan hane karşı örneğiyle birlikte, burada biyolojik yazgıdan çok toplumsal çevrenin belli bir ahlaki tipi üretmesini öne çıkarır.
Allah'ın kullarının saptırılması, hizmeti ortadan kaldırmaz; onu korunmuş başka ilahlara yönelterek kulluk yönünü ele geçirir.
Günahkârlıktaki dışa doğru yarılma ile inkârdaki içe doğru örtme, sınırı dışarıdan yıkan fakat hakikati içeride kapatan ikili bir bozulma biçimi kurar.
Suyun yarılarak akması ile tohum ve meyvenin örtülmesi çağrışımları, önceki verimli su ve bitki düzeninin bozulmuş bir yetiştirme çevrimine dönüştüğü benzetmesini önerir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Human Life Is Planted, Returned, and Raised
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human existence follows a cultivated cycle of placement in earth, growth, return, and renewed emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Agriculture, burial, education, and biological descent become phases of one generative process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Burial is a return to the source before emergence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject re-enters its originating ground, disappears within a terminal dwelling, and is brought outward again.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: return after departure (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); place and time of return (`quranic:root_001058:B002/m01`); repeated visitation of the sick or mourning place (`quranic:root_001058:B005/m01`); benefit that returns to its recipient (`quranic:root_001058:B006/m01`); ancient return-road (`quranic:root_001058:B009/m01`); entering a place or state (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); penetration to the outside (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); extraction from concealment (`quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`); grave as a house (`quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`); remote village or grave (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); disappearance into earth (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); clinging to the ground (`quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Return, entry, disappearance, grave-house, extraction, and exit form one reversible spatial sequence. Earth is not merely the place of disposal; it is the prior source and temporary interior from which renewed outward movement is possible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Human Life Is Planted, Returned, and Raised
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human existence follows a cultivated cycle of placement in earth, growth, return, and renewed emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Agriculture, burial, education, and biological descent become phases of one generative process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Offspring are new growth carrying prior formation forward
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Birth produces descendants whose bodily and moral formation extends a lineage into a new cycle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: child or descendant (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); parents as source of birth (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); recently born child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); derivative generated from a prior thing (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); peer of the same birth-age (`quranic:root_001683:B006/m01`); new human generation (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); human upbringing (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); pregnancy becoming visibly apparent (`quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`); completed created form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Birth, derivative formation, peer generation, and upbringing all make offspring more than numerical additions. Each child is a new growth generated from prior embodied and social material. That continuity makes moral reproduction in 71:27 a concrete extension of the creation cycle.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Prepared Ground Becomes Route, Dwelling, and Contested Residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space is made usable by spreading, opening, traversing, and inhabiting it; judgment then contests who may remain and who may enter a protected house.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The earth-carpet is not passive scenery but civic infrastructure whose routes lead either to inhabited refuge or to an emptied settlement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The inhabited earth can be emptied of its rejecting householder
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Residence becomes the object of removal until a formerly inhabited territory contains no remaining occupant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: absence of any resident (`quranic:root_000499:B008/m01`); terminal hostile circuit around a group (`quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`); staying fixed to the ground (`quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`); remote or cut-off settlement (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); abandoning and leaving (`quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`); dwelling and shelter (`quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`); destruction and breaking (`quranic:root_000174:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The prayer's resident is not just an isolated individual. Dwelling, fixed attachment, settlement, and hostile encirclement make residence a durable claim; leaving and breaking reverse it. The prepared earth can therefore move from hospitable infrastructure to a territory deliberately cleared of a destructive occupancy.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Following Converts Increase Into Multiplying Loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Allegiance propagates a governing direction, so assets and descendants amplify either ordered life or the loss already embedded in their leader.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Loss behaves like a bad balance sheet and a reproductive process: capital, claims, speech, followers, and offspring all enlarge the same deficit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Error reproduces itself through numbers and generation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Misguidance spreads across a crowd and then through offspring, turning a present deviation into a durable lineage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deviation from path and guidance (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); loss of the thing or its location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); failed retention and memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); increase and accretion (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); multiplication of number (`quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`); new human generation (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); derivative generated from a prior source (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); transgressive rupture (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`); covering and denial of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); coercion into disobedience (`quranic:root_001307:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The process has both horizontal and vertical propagation. Deviation spreads through many contemporaries, then childbirth and derivation carry it into another generation. Forgetting and loss show how guidance disappears from transmission, while coercion explains how a formed social system can make later disobedience easier.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Cult Objects Bind Affection to Fabrication and Predation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An idol gains social force by being made, named, loved, circled, and endowed with a predatory persona.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cult object moves from plastered artifact and cherished name to beak, claw, thief, and raiding detachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affection and wish fasten worshipers to the name
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Love, desire, and cherished expectation make a named object emotionally adhesive.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affection and mutual attachment (`quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`); wishing for a desired outcome (`quranic:root_001634:B002/m01`); idol named Wadd (`quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`); worshipful subjection (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); honoring and magnifying (`quranic:root_000973:B006/m01`); inward magnification (`quranic:root_001281:B003/m01`); elevated inherited prestige (`quranic:root_001281:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The name Wadd opens a complete affective mechanism. Love and wish attach the worshiper, honor raises the object, and inward magnification lets inherited prestige feel self-validating. Idolatry is thereby sustained by emotional investment as well as assertion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Covering Divides Denial, Burial, and Mercy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes what remains available to sight, memory, consequence, or protection; its moral force depends on what is covered and for what end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Seed-cover, truth-cover, grave, flood, expiation, and forgiveness are materially similar operations with opposed outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Denial covers truth and benefit at their source
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject places a screen over disclosed truth and over the benefit already received, preventing acknowledgment from reaching either.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); denial and concealment of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); covering a benefit by ingratitude (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); darkness or vast water as engulfing cover (`quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`); seed hidden by soil (`quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`); withdrawal and disavowal (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); transgressive rupture of a protective boundary (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Covering moves from physical screen to epistemic and ethical operation. Truth is made unavailable, benefit is detached from gratitude, and disavowal removes relational responsibility. Seed-cover shows that concealment can serve life, which exposes denial's distortion: it covers not to protect emergence but to prevent recognition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Covering Divides Denial, Burial, and Mercy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering changes what remains available to sight, memory, consequence, or protection; its moral force depends on what is covered and for what end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Seed-cover, truth-cover, grave, flood, expiation, and forgiveness are materially similar operations with opposed outcomes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Engulfment hides body, route, and memory
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water, earth, or darkness occupies the subject's whole field until location, route, and retained trace disappear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sinking under water to destruction (`quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`); total occupation of a field (`quranic:root_001080:B005/m01`); ground filled with water (`quranic:root_001080:B003/m01`); disappearance and burial (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); loss of location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); loss from memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); remote grave or settlement (`quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`); lower realm beneath another (`quranic:root_000502:B001/m01`); entering an enclosing state (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 71:18 (`خ ر ج` as the counter-operation); 71:24 and 71:27 (`ض ل ل`); 71:25 (`غ ر ق`, `د خ ل`, `د و ن`); 71:26-27 (`ك ف ر`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Immersion does more than kill. It removes coordinates, interrupts the route, suppresses the trace, and turns the surrounding medium into a total cover. The later promise of exit from earth stands as the exact counter-operation to this disappearance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 71:15-28] Household Continuity Forks Into Corrupt and Believing Succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A household transmits identity through birth, upbringing, following, and admission; the transmitted direction can reproduce rebellion or secure trust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lineage is a transmission system rather than a guarantee: biological generation, fostered formation, social imitation, and house-entry can carry opposed inheritances.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Birth can reproduce an already corrupted pattern
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Existing rebellion shapes upbringing and succession so that a new child emerges inside the same moral trajectory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); child and descendant (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); derivative generated from a prior source (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`); new generation within a people (`quranic:root_001465:B003/m01`); human upbringing (`quranic:root_001465:B006/m01`); low and debased growth (`quranic:root_001465:B008/m01`); following and imitation (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); uninterrupted succession (`quranic:root_000175:B004/m01`); departure from obedience (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`); transgressive rupture (`quranic:root_001132:B004/m01`); denial of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Biology supplies continuity, but following and upbringing give that continuity direction. The child is a derivative in both bodily and social senses, so entrenched rebellion can enter the next generation before it appears as an independent choice.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın anlamı ayrı bir et parçasıdır. Bunun yanında tek bir aktarım etsiz bir kemik parçasından söz eder; ayrıca çok sayıda et parçası içeren yemek kullanımı, adın temel anlamını değiştirmeyen yapıya bağlı bir uygulamadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel ad anlamı et parçasıyla sınırlıdır; etsiz kemik açıklaması bir kaynak ayrılığı, yemek örneği ise yapıya bağlı kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız adın et ya da aktarıma göre kemik parçası anlamını, bol et parçalı yemek yapısından ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Başlıca anlamı bütünden ayrılmış bir et parçasıdır; bir aktarımda bunun yerine üzerinde et bulunmayan bir kemik parçası gösterilir. Çoğul nitelikli kullanım, bir ekmek yemeğinde çok sayıda et parçası bulunmasını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği bir şeyi bırakmak ya da kendi haline koymaktır. Ancak kullanım geçmiş zaman ve bağımsız eylem adı yerine geniş zaman ile emir biçimlerinde yaşar; değersiz görülen şeyi bir yana atma yorumu da çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bırakma anlamı korunmalı, sınırlı çekim düzeni ve küçümseyerek bir yana atma uzantısı ayrıca belirtilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, geniş zaman ve emir biçimlerindeki bırakma çekirdeğini, belirli nesneli yapıları ve küçümseyerek atma uzantısını ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi olduğu yerde ya da kendi halinde bırakmak, onunla ilgilenmekten vazgeçmektir. Kullanım geniş zaman ve emir biçimlerinde sürer; değersiz görülen bir şeyi bir yana atma anlamına da uzanabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bırakmayı veya kendi haline koymayı belirtir.
Eylem geniş zaman ve emir biçimlerinde kullanılır; geçmiş zaman biçimi ile bağımsız eylem adı kullanım dışıdır.
Değersiz görülen bir şeyi önemsemeyerek bir yana atmayı anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bırakma ve kendi haline koyma çekirdeğinde birleşir; kullanımın geniş zaman ve emir biçimleriyle sınırlı olduğunu, eylem adının başka bir bırakma sözüyle anlatıldığını ve küçümseyerek bir yana atma uzantısını da kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın temel bırakma anlamı, özel çekim biçimlerinden bağımsız olarak kısa biçimde gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyle ilgiyi kesip onu kendi halinde bırakma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bırakma eyleminin doğrudan emir biçiminde söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Emir biçimini ve nesneyi kendi halinde bırakma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bırakmanın, nesneye az değer verme nedeniyle onu atma biçiminde gerçekleştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Az değer verme gerekçesini ve bir yana atma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: önemsiz gördüğü şeyi bir yana atmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyle ilgilenmeme sonucunu kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi bilinçli olarak bırakma ya da kendi haline koyma işlemini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bellekten silinme veya hatırlayamama anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Bırakma eylemini zihinsel bir başarısızlıkla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli geniş zaman ve emir biçimleriyle sınırlıdır ve küçümseyerek bir yana atma uzantısı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal terk etme, salıverme, ilgisiz bırakma ve hayvan ya da malı engellemeden koyma gibi daha geniş kullanımlara sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesne üzerindeki ilgiyi ya da müdahaleyi sona erdirip onu bırakmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam çekirdekleri büyük ölçüde örtüşse de odak dalın çekim düzeni ve küçümseme uzantısı özeldir; komşu dalın kullanım alanı ve bırakma türleri daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın yaşayan biçimleri geniş zaman ve emirdir; ayrıca değersiz sayılan şeyi atmayı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bırakmanın isteyerek ya da zorunlu oluşunu, reddetmeyi ve bir şeyi almadan koymayı açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bir şeyi bırakmak, reddetmek veya serbest koymak
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi almama, sürdürmeme veya kendi haline bırakma bağlamında kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal niyet ve zorunluluk bakımından daha geniş bir bırakma alanı kurar; odak dal ise anlamca yakın olmakla birlikte biçimsel olarak sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, uzamsal bir geride bırakma ilişkisi olmadan da yalın bırakma emrini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesneyi arkada bırakmayı, geriye atmayı veya oradan ayrılarak terk etmeyi belirginleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesneyle ilgiyi kesip onu bırakma sonucunda örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalda geride kalma ya da ayrılma yönü belirgindir; odak dalın çekirdeği böyle bir uzamsal yön gerektirmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sabit bir sesleniş kalıbının sövme ve yüz kızartıcı suçlama amacıyla kullanıldığını açıkça gösterir. Cinsel gönderimin açıklaması erkek cinsel organları ile sünnet derisi arasında değişir; ilgili ad biçiminin klitoris anlamı ise bu kalıptan ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sabit sövgü kalıbı ile bağımsız adın anatomik anlamı ayrılmalı, cinsel gönderimin değişken açıklaması tek bir organa indirgenmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, cinsel göndermeli sabit sövgü kalıplarını bağımsız ad biçiminin klitoris anlamından açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Sabit bir sesleniş kalıbında, cinsel organlara üstü kapalı gönderme yoluyla kişiye ve soyuna yöneltilen ağır bir sövgüdür; gönderimin erkek cinsel organları ya da sünnet derisi olduğu açıklanır. Bundan ayrı olarak ilgili ad biçimi klitorisi adlandırır.

facets.statement: Sabit bir sesleniş kalıbı, kişiye ve soyuna yöneltilen ağır sövgü ve yüz kızartıcı suçlama işlevi görür.
Kalıptaki cinsel gönderim erkek cinsel organları ya da sünnet derisi olarak farklı biçimlerde açıklanır.
Sövgü kalıbından ayrı olan ilgili ad biçimi kadın klitorisini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt sabit kalıbın ağır sövgü ve yüz kızartıcı suçlama işlevinde birleşir. Cinsel imanın hangi anatomik öğeye dayandığı konusunda erkek cinsel organları ile sünnet derisi açıklamaları bulunur; ayrıca bağımsız ad biçimi klitoris için kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yapıya bağlı sövgü anlamı ile bağımsız adın anatomik anlamının aynı dalda fakat ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit cinsel sövgü çekirdeğini ve ayrı ad biçiminin anatomik anlamını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Sövgünün ağırlığını, soy hedefini ve cinsel göndermesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca bağımsız ad biçiminin kadın anatomisine ilişkin anlamı çevrildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadın anatomisindeki belirli organı doğrudan adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlamın çekirdeğini amaçtan, doğru yoldan ve doğruluktan ayrılma olarak kurar; hem yolunu bulamama hem de yanlış ve boş işlere yönelme bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir. Başkasını doğru yoldan uzaklaştıran ettirgen kullanım da aynı anlam alanına bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel olarak gözden yitme, bir şeyi kaybetme, unutma ya da kayıp hayvan adı olma anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sapma çekirdeğini korur; yol, arazi, kişiyi sapmış sayma ve bir işi yanlış tutumla yapma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin amaçtan, doğru yoldan veya doğruluktan ayrılması, yolunu bulamaması ya da yanlış ve boş olana yönelmesidir. Ettirgen kullanımda başka biri bu doğrultudan uzaklaştırılır.

facets.statement: Amaçtan, doğru yoldan veya doğruluktan ayrılma ve uygun yönü bulamama anlamın temelidir.
Yanlış, asılsız veya boş işlere yönelme, yönsel sapmanın düşünce ve davranış alanındaki uzantısıdır.
Ettirgen kullanım, başka birini doğru yoldan veya amaçtan uzaklaştırmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, doğru yönün ve amacın dışına çıkmayı doğruluk ve kılavuzluk karşıtı bir durum olarak verir; yol bulamama, yoğun sapma, yanlış işlere dalma ve başkasını saptırma bu alan içinde yer alır.

concept_gloss.text: doğru yoldan ve amaçtan sapma ya da başkasını saptırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yönsel, düşünsel ve davranışsal çekirdeği ile buna bağlı ettirgen kullanımı birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğru yön veya amaçtan ayrılmayı ve başkasını aynı doğrultudan uzaklaştırmayı korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan gizlenme ve gözden yitme çekirdeğini verir; toprağa karışıp görünmez olma, bir sıvı içinde eriyip seçilemez hale gelme ve ölüyü gömme bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Bu nedenle geçici dal çerçevesi kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada belirleyici olan görünmez hale gelmedir; sahibinden yitme, yerini bulamama ve bellekte tutamama ayrı dallara aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel gizlenme çekirdeğiyle birlikte yalnız belirli yapılarda görülen sıvı içinde erime ve ölüyü gömme anlamlarını birbirine karıştırmadan belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gizlenerek, toprağa karışarak ya da başka bir maddenin içinde seçilemez hale gelerek gözden yitmesidir. Ölüyü gömmek, onu görünmez kılan özel bir ettirgen kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gizlenmesi ve algılanamaz biçimde gözden yitmesi temel anlamdır.
Bir sıvının başka bir sıvı içinde eriyip seçilemez hale gelmesi özel bir gerçekleşmedir.
Ölüyü toprağa gömerek gözden kaldırmak, görünmez kılma sonucuna dayanan ettirgen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, bir şeyin görünür alandan çıkıp gizlenmesini temel alır; toprağa karışıp seçilemez olma, sıvı içinde erime ve ölünün gömülerek görünmez kılınması bu çekirdeğe bağlanır. Bir şeyi bir başkasından gizleyip uzak tutma da aynı ettirgen sonuçla açıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hareketli bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesini ve sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamayı aynı bulamama alanında toplar. Kanın öçsüz kalması ise kaybın sahiplik değil karşılık ve talep bakımından kurulduğu özel, kalıba bağlı bir uzantıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal nesnenin görünmez oluşunu veya bellekteki bilginin silinmesini değil, elden çıkmayı ve yerini bulamamayı temel alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel yitirme çekirdeğini, hareketli bir şeyi kaybetme, sabit bir yerin konumunu bulamama ve kanın karşılıksız kalması gibi yapıya bağlı yüzlerden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sahibinin elinden çıkması veya kişinin hareketli bir şeyi ya da sabit bir yerin konumunu bulamamasıdır. Özel bir kullanımda öldürülen kişinin kanı öç alınmadan ve karşılık aranmadan kalır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesi ve nerede olduğunun bilinememesi temel yitirme ilişkisidir.
Ev, ibadet yeri veya başka sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamak, nesneyi değil yolu bulamama biçimidir.
Bir işin elden kaçması ve ona erişecek yolun bulunamaması, yitirme ilişkisinin soyut uzantısıdır.
Öldürülen kişinin kanının öç alınmadan kalması, kaybı karşılıksız kalma sonucuna bağlayan özel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, bir hayvanın veya başka bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesini, bir kimsenin nereye gittiğinin bilinememesini ve kişinin sabit bir yerin konumunu bulamamasını aynı erişememe alanında birleştirir; işin elden kaçması ve kanın öçsüz kalması özel uzantılardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir genel eylemden çok üç yapıya bağlı kullanımı yan yana verir: çok geçilerek düzleşmiş yol, katranlanmış ve uysallaştırılmış deve, katran veya yağla kaplanmış gemi. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar tek bir yalın anlammış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım yalnızca verilen yol, deve ve gemi yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; insanı köleleştirme anlamına genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal söz öbeğine bağlı yol ve deve anlamlarıyla bir gemi adlandırmasını birlikte taşır; her kullanım kendi nesnesi ve işlemiyle ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Verilen yapılarda yolun çok geçilerek düzleşip kolay kullanılır olması, devenin derisinin katranla kaplanıp uysallaştırılması veya geminin katran, yağ ya da benzeri bir maddeyle kaplanması anlatılır.

facets.statement: Yol kullanımı, sık geçişle basılıp düzleşmiş ve geçişe elverişli hâle gelmiş yolu niteler.
Deve kullanımı, derisi baştan başa katranlanmış ve bununla birlikte uysallaştırılmış hayvanı niteler.
Gemi kullanımı, dışı katran, yağ veya benzeri koruyucu maddeyle kaplanmış tekneyi niteler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, yol için basılıp düzleşmeyi; deve için katranlanma ve uysallaşmayı; gemi içinse katran ya da yağla kaplanmayı ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: düzleşmiş yol, katranlanmış deve veya kaplanmış gemi
concept_gloss.applicability: Üç yapıdaki ayrı nesne ve işlemleri yalın bir kök anlamına genellemeden birlikte temsil eder.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin yol için kullanıldığı ve sık geçiş sonucu düzleşmeyi anlattığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Yol ve deve kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nitelenen kişinin saygı gösterilen, yüceltilen ve hizmet edilen biri olduğunu açıkça belirtir. Bu anlam, benzer biçimin ezilmiş veya kullanıma hazırlanmış nesneyi nitelediği daldan karşıt bir değerle ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, saygı ve hizmet gören kişiyi niteler; alçaltma, köleleştirme veya nesneyi işleme anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir niteleme anlamıdır; özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı ek kapsam gerektirmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nitelemeyi saygı görme, yüceltilme ve hizmet edilme özelliklerini bir arada taşıyan kişi için kullanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği güç ve sağlamlık olarak verir; dayanıklılık ve kalıcılık bunun zaman içindeki görünümü, dişi devedeki semizlik ise canlıya özgü belirti olarak sunulur. Bunlar kölelik veya boyun eğmeyle ilişkili değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel güç, sağlamlık ve dayanıklılığı anlatır; toplumsal kölelik ya da duygusal öfke anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın güç adı ile deve ve kumaşa bağlı söz öbekleri birlikte bulunur; canlıya özgü semizlik bütün dalın genel anlamı yapılmaz.

Kumaş bağlamında güç, kullanıma karşı dayanma ve kalıcılık olarak görünür.
Dişi deve bağlamında güçlü yapıya semizlik de eklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar güç ve sağlamlık çekirdeğinde birleşir; bunu kumaşın dayanması ve dişi devenin güçlü, semiz yapısı üzerinden somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu merkezde verir; ayrıca keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı aktarır. Geçici çerçevedeki kaçırılmış şey için pişmanlık ayrıntısı kaynak cümlesinde açık değildir, bu yüzden tanım bu ek koşula bağlanmadan kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal incinmiş gururdan yükselen öfke ile kederli iç duygulanımı kapsar; güç ve sağlamlık anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın duygu adı ile gururu incindiği için susmayı anlatan söz öbeği birlikte bulunur; susma yalnız özel kullanımın sonucudur.

facets.statement: Duygu incinmiş gurur, onurunu koruma isteği ve öfke çevresinde oluşur.
Kaynak ifadesi anlamı keder ve yoğun iç sıkıntısına da uzatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar incinmiş gurur, öfke ve kendini koruma duygusunu ortak çekirdek yapar; bazı aktarımlar keder ve yoğun iç duygulanımı da aynı ad altında verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı söz öbeğine bağlı anlam verir: bir işi yapmakta gecikmemek ve koşarken bir ölçü hızlanmak. Bunlar tek bir yalın eylem anlamına indirgenemez, fakat dal iki yapı açıkça ayrılarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen iki söz öbeğinde gecikmeme veya biraz hızlanma bildirir; genel bir hız kökü gibi yorumlanmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, babayı doğum bağı yönünden baba, anayı da aynı yönden ana olarak adlandırır ve ikisini birlikte bir çift halinde verir. Dal çerçevesi bu üçlü dağılımı doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ana baba, çocuğa göre doğum bağı taşıyan iki kişidir; çocuk, bakıcı veya daha uzak büyükler bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ana, baba ve ikisini birlikte gösteren adlandırmayla sınırlıdır; başka aile veya bakım ilişkileri içeri alınmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kadının çocuğunu dünyaya getirmesini çekirdek yapar; doğum zamanının gelmesi, gebe koyun, koyunun doğumunu üstlenme ve doğulan gün kullanımlarını da aynı dalda bildirir. Verilen çerçeve bu olay ile ona bağlı kullanımları ayırt etmeye elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğmuş çocuğun kendisini değil doğurma olayını ve kaynakta açıkça verilen olaya bağlı kullanımları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın çekirdek doğurma olayıdır; zaman, gebe koyun ve doğuma yardım bildiren kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadının çocuğunu bedeninden çıkararak dünyaya getirmesi. Buna bağlı kullanımlar doğum zamanının gelmesini, gebe koyunu, koyunun doğumunu üstlenmeyi ve doğulan günü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek olay, kadının çocuğunu dünyaya getirmesidir.
Bir dişinin doğum zamanının gelmesi ayrıca belirtilir.
Hayvan bağlamında gebe koyun bu söz alanındaki özel bir nitelemeyle gösterilir.
Bir koyunun doğumunu üstlenmek veya doğumuna yardım etmek ayrıca anlatılır.
Bir kişinin doğduğu gün, olayın zamanını belirten kullanım örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt doğurma olayını merkeze alır; doğum vaktinin gelmesini, gebe koyunu, doğuma yardım etmeyi ve kişinin doğduğu günü bu olay çevresindeki kullanımlar olarak verir.

error_profile.collision: Doğurma olayı ile bütün çoğalma sürecini birbirine karıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğumun genel gerçekleşmesini gösterir; komşu dal aynı olayın güçlükle gerçekleşen özel durumuna daralır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkek biçimi için yeni doğmuş çocuk, ergenlik öncesi oğlan ve erkek köleyi; kadın biçimi için kız çocuk ile kadın köleyi birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesindeki çocuk ve köle yönleri uygundur, ancak çocuk yönü yalnız yeni doğmuşlukla sınırlandırılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Erkek biçimin çocuk yönü yeni doğmuş çocuk yanında ergenlik öncesi oğlanı da kapsar; kadın biçimi kız çocuğu ve kadın köle için kullanılır, köle anlamı özellikle kadın biçiminde yaş şartına bağlı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin çocuk ve köle yönlerini birlikte korur; genel çocuk anlamı veya herhangi bir hizmetçilik ilişkisi içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Erkek biçimde yakın zamanda doğmuş çocuk veya ergenlik öncesi oğlan; kadın biçimde kız çocuk; ayrıca erkek ya da kadın köle. Kadın köle anlamı kişinin ileri yaşta olmasına karşın sürebilir.

facets.statement: Erkek biçimi yakın zamanda doğmuş çocuk veya ergenlik öncesi oğlan için kullanılır.
Erkek biçimi bir erkek köleyi de gösterebilir.
Kadın biçimi kız çocuğunu gösterebilir.
Kadın biçimi kadın köleyi gösterir ve bu kullanım ileri yaşta da geçerli olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt erkek biçimi yeni doğmuş çocuk, ergenlik öncesi oğlan ve erkek köleye; kadın biçimi kız çocuk ile kadın köleye dağıtır. Kadın köle adlandırmasının ileri yaşta da kullanılabildiği ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Erkek ve kadın biçimlerinin çocuk ile köle yönlerini birlikte özetler; kadın kölede yaş sınırlaması bulunmadığını açıklama tamamlar.
